title: External contribution + review-scaling model (esp. correctness gate)
context: open-coding-curriculum is an open CC-BY (prose) / MIT (code) curriculum of beginner programming lessons with graded, runnable exercises across languages. Every exercise carries a reference solution proven correct in CI (solutionVerified:true), learner code runs zero-install in-browser via WASM, and all content is machine-readable structured data so third parties can build on it. The project targets absolute beginners — self-learners, public-library patrons, under-resourced school students, career-changers — and operates under a donated-compute lane with no server-side execution of learner code and no partner confirmed yet (verifiedNeed:false). When external contributions open, the review burden — especially the correctness gate and pedagogy checklist — must scale. Without a documented contribution model, well-meaning external authors will bypass the correctness gate or submit content that cannot be reviewed in time, creating a backlog and quality risk.
objective: Design and document a scalable external contribution model that specifies how external authors submit lessons/exercises, how the correctness gate is applied to contributed content, how reviewer rotation works, and what the review SLA is.
acceptanceCriteria: Contribution model specifies: how to submit a new lesson (PR format, required files, checklist), the minimum bar to pass CI (schema validity, correctness gate, starter-must-fail), and the reviewer assignment process.
Correctness gate is non-negotiable for external contributions: any lesson/exercise that fails the CI correctness gate cannot be merged regardless of author.
Reviewer rotation model is specified: how technical and pedagogy reviewers are recruited, rotated, and tracked; what the expected review turnaround is.
The model addresses the audit sampling rule (≥ 10% of published lessons re-audited per cycle) for a growing corpus.
The model is reviewed by the Maintainer and at least one external contributor (if available) before publication.
output: A committed external contribution and review-scaling model document, covering submission process, correctness gate requirements, reviewer rotation, and audit sampling.
